companyDescription: Rare respiratory · MOLBREEVI (inhaled molgramostim) for autoimmune pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (aPAP) — BLA under Priority Review, PDUFA Nov 22, 2026
priceNote: Live $4.92 on Nov 11, 2026. The 52-week range is $4.00–$7.01. Market cap is ~$1.15B. The PDUFA (Nov 22, a Sunday, so the decision is likely by Fri Nov 20 or Mon Nov 23) is 11 days out.
summary: The Nov 22, 2026 PDUFA for MOLBREEVI (inhaled GM-CSF for aPAP) under Priority Review is the binary. It is a resubmitted BLA, and the date was extended from Aug 22 by a major amendment. MOLBREEVI would be the first approved aPAP therapy in the US. Consensus targets of ~$10.56 (Simply Wall St; ~$8.8–10.6 range across providers, dated Apr 2026 and so best-effort) imply ~+115% and clear the 20% gate even at the low end (~+80%). fda_decision is a core lane type with no Tier-2 laggard flag (laggard: partnership_win). The catalyst is 11 days out, inside the 14-day North Star window. Core Base bias is +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a ~4–8 week post-earnings re-rating horizon, not a 14-day call. Size 2–3%. Event-day cluster: CAPR also has a Nov 22 PDUFA on the board.

catalysts.name: MOLBREEVI PDUFA — aPAP (Priority Review)
catalysts.description: Resubmitted BLA; target action date Nov 22, 2026, extended from Aug 22 after a major amendment. It would be the first US-approved therapy for autoimmune PAP.

risks: Resubmission history: the original BLA hit a refuse-to-file/CMC snag, and the date was already extended once. Another CRL is possible.
Approval-likely pricing: the stock has not run, but a clean approval may still be a +20–40% event rather than a multiple re-rate.
Ultra-rare market (aPAP) means launch revenue ramps slowly.
Consensus target data is stale (Apr 2026), so upside is a best-effort estimate.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset rare-disease biotech. The PDUFA dominates; rates matter only through small-cap biotech risk appetite.
macroRisk.summary: LOW-MEDIUM — the binary (Nov 22) lands before the Nov 25 PCE and the Dec 9 FOMC. The regulatory clock is independent of the Fed.
